tests.name: commuting_self_operation_has_no_negative_to_positive_component
tests.note: For e_-=(1,0), the positive component of A e_- is a10; commutation forces it to zero.

tests.name: noncommuting_negative_to_positive_flip_exists
tests.note: Without the commutation premise, A=|+><-| maps e_- to e_+ and fails to commute with sigma_hat.

tests.name: three_state_domain_alone_allows_reversion
tests.note: The status set {-1,0,+1} alone does not prohibit a +1 to -1 transition.

tests.name: absorbing_positive_status_forbids_reversion
tests.note: The explicit transition graph makes +1 absorbing, so +1 to -1 is impossible.

tests.name: idempotent_grace_and_nilpotent_conversion_coexist
tests.note: A model exists with separate G^2=G and L^2=0 operators, with G fixing e_+ and L mapping e_- to e_+.
